summary: Strong west and northwest breezes will kick up enough surf for a high risk of rip currents. In fact, west-facing beaches in Gulf County will be most directly exposed, and surf heights will reach 5 feet today. Winds will start to diminish on Friday, but not soon enough to prevent one more day of high risk concerns on Friday. High risk on Saturday will be confined to west-facing Gulf County beaches. Then on Sunday, fresh to strong southerlies over the Gulf will push surf directly onto the beaches for a high risk at all beaches.
